data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Classification: llm-behavioral. Applied targeted SKILL.md edits per reporter suggestions: (1) Step 13 anti-pattern guard listing prohibited shutdown rationales (% context, sub-agent cost, partial completion, user-can-merge); (2) Phase K entry-gate explicitly bounded to two paths (J=ALL_PASS+zero-bugs OR literal compaction banner); (3) Phase L 'non-skippable' clause prohibiting Phase L offload to user. Fix is behavioral guidance — full enforcement requires the breadcrumb mechanism the reporter suggested as follow-up.
